description: This file defines data models for a quiz application, specifically the 'QuizCatalog' and 'QuizQuestion' classes used to represent quizzes and questions with associated metadata.

classes.name: QuizCatalog
classes.description: Represents a full quiz with multiple questions, metadata, and category information. Includes convenience methods like questionCount.

classes.name: QuizQuestion
classes.description: Models a single multiple-choice question with options, correct answer index, and optional explanation.

methods.name: questionCount
methods.description: Returns the number of questions in the quiz.

methods.name: isCorrect
methods.description: Checks if a given index corresponds to the correct answer.
